hero.title: Embrace the beauty within.
hero.description: JS Beauty & Threading offers expert care in threading, lashes, waxing, facials and more—so you can look and feel your absolute best, every day.

about.title: Nourish your natural beauty
about.summary: We believe beauty begins with self-respect. Every treatment is tailored to your features, comfort and routine in a welcoming space where you can slow down and feel at home.
story: Founder Sita Pandit built her beauty career through more than a decade of hands-on experience, continuous learning and a genuine love for helping clients feel confident.

Her specialty began with threading, brow shaping and waxing, then grew into a complete beauty practice offering lashes, facials and henna. Every service is guided by attentive consultation and precise technique.
Today, JS Beauty & Threading brings that same personal approach to Pinole: a warm salon for every client who values thoughtful service, quality products and results that still feel like themselves.

policies.appointments: Appointments are encouraged. Walk-ins are welcomed when availability allows.

policies.health: Please disclose allergies, sensitivities, medications or skin conditions before your treatment.
